bias.en: Downtrend · rebound back above the 5 and 10-day
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 反弹重回 5 日和 10 日均线上方

read.en: Rockwell Automation rose 1.2% on Nov 18 to $395.86, trading $390.27–400.78. It is above the 10-day ($392.8, falling) and just above the 5-day ($395.7, rising), and below the 30-day ($420.2), 200-day ($426.0) and 100-day ($438.1), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($429.78), and RSI is 42.0.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月18日上涨 1.2%，收于 $395.86，盘中区间 $390.27–400.78。股价位于 10 日均线（$392.8，下行）上方，略高于 5 日均线（$395.7，上行），位于 30 日（$420.2）、200 日（$426.0）和 100 日均线（$438.1）下方，三者均在下行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$429.78），RSI 为 42.0。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $392.5–395.1 band (Nov 6, 16 and 17 highs) and the 5 and 10-day averages, now support, but the $400.78 high stalled under $401.7. Resistance is $397.2–398.3 (Nov 10 close, Nov 13 low), then $400.8–402.5 and $404.2–406.2 (Nov 11–12 closes). Support is $392.8–395.7, then $388.4–391.3 and $383.1–384.7. A close above $402.5 would target $404–406; below $388.4, $383–385.

s.en: Nov 10 low $388.41; Nov 18 low $390.27; Nov 17 close $391.26
